label: GO step after an a1 choice that reached S2 by a rare transition, strongest when that trial was rewarded
explanation: Fires only at GO (0 activations at D1/D2). 84% of activation mass comes from GO steps whose previous trial was a1 -> S2 rare (prev_action==1 & prev_common==0); after a2 or common transitions it is almost silent (5% of mass). Magnitude is highest (near max) when that rare trial was rewarded (the model-based switch case for a1); after a1 rare unrewarded it fires weakly (~0.1-0.2 of max), which is the source of most missed activations. Recorded the rewarded version (dev P 0.60 R 0.53 F1 0.56, mass recall 0.75); the broader rare-after-a1 predicate has recall 0.80 but precision 0.27. Activation also grows strongly with episode trial (rate 0.2% in trials 0-9 vs 3% in trials 80-89); restricting to ep_trial>=50 raises precision to 0.80 but halves recall. False positives are mostly early-episode or high-value histories with many prior rewards. All variables are observed at GO.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over last trial (GO: a1 S2 r, a1 S2 u, a2 S2 r) and trial before (GO: a1 S1 u, a1 S2 u, a2 S2 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=GO & ep_dec=8, phase=GO & ep_dec=9, phase=GO & ep_dec=7.
